events.title: El Reno, Oklahoma · May 31, 2013
events.summary: On May 31, 2013, a tornado formed southwest of El Reno, Oklahoma, and passed south of the town and airport before turning northeast. The National Weather Service reports a maximum width of 2.6 miles and a final damage rating of EF3. Eight people died, all in vehicles. The visible condensation, surveyed damage and radar-measured winds describe different aspects of the tornado.
